audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 is right for a 625-range immobile mage into an 815-range poke mage with a 9s shield, even at 56.53% over 704 games — the win rate comes from the level 4+ rows, not from lane safety.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side reads Skill on rows 0-5 and Orianna on row 6; content win[] reads Orianna, Orianna, Skill, Annie, Annie, Annie, Annie — the two layers disagree on six of seven rows, including a straight inversion at 2+ items.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly. The full layer's phases[0].why and [1].why also describe an Annie-favoured level 1-2 that the win rate and the range gap do not support.
audit.corrected: Flip the full layer to Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie and rewrite phases[0].why and [1].why to explain Orianna's early edge (815 Q range, Command: Protect on 9s).

audit.whatIsWrong: The `early` field and wants.foe[1] both say Orianna pokes with Command: Dissonance from safe range; wants.foe[2] calls the ultimate 'Shockwave'.
audit.why: Command: Dissonance (W) is 225 range — a pulse around the ball, not a poke tool. The 815-range poke is Command: Attack (Q, 7/6/5/4/3s). The ultimate's full name is Command: Shockwave (110/95/80s, 410 range) and it launches enemies toward the ball, which is the single most important positional fact in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Name Command: Attack as the poke, and tell the player to watch the ball's position because Shockwave pulls toward the ball, not toward Orianna.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/R text and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere — the cooldown field says 'count it out loud' without naming a duration.
audit.why: Command: Shockwave is 110s at rank 1 and Command: Protect is a flat 9s. Those two numbers are the entire timing of the lane.
audit.corrected: Bait Command: Protect (9s), then commit; step up on the 110s Shockwave window.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 favor Orianna clearly: her ball attached to herself grants a shield that blunts your stun-into-burst combo, and she can poke you with Command: Dissonance from safe range while you're forced to walk up. Farm cautiously and look for moments she detaches the ball to poke a minion wave, since that's your window to punish her without the shield absorbing your damage.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 favor Orianna clearly: Command: Protect attaches the ball to herself for a shield that blunts your stun-into-burst combo, and she pokes with Command: Attack from 815 while your Q only reaches 625. Farm cautiously and look for the moments she leaves the ball parked out in the wave, since that's your window to punish her without the shield absorbing your damage.

notes: Two real ability errors: `early` and wants.foe[1] both had Orianna poking with Command: Dissonance, which is a 225-range pulse around the ball, not a poke spell — the poke is Command: Attack at 815. The packet's suspectName on wants.foe[2] ('Hold Shockwave') was a genuine hit; corrected to Command: Shockwave. Level chart was inverted between layers on six of seven rows, including 2+ items reading Orianna on the full layer and Annie on the content layer; the content layer matches packet.levelChart, so the full layer was flipped as one atomic group and phases[0]/[1].why rewritten to actually justify an Orianna-favoured early game. Orianna is female; corrected the pronouns in the fields I touched.
